core_struggle: His visa depends on a job rating; his wife gave up her career for this; his mind checks work am and has not rested in weeks.
mirror: You check the messages am, and the weekend you planned to rest is already a thought about work.

queries.hook: The terror of a rating that could end the visa, and the mind that will not stop running until it has checked every message.
queries.diagnose: Fear grows from imagining the future and from forgetting that what is real in us cannot be lost; worry multiplies what has not happened.
queries.steady: What is real in you cannot be lost, and what is not real is what you are losing sleep over; hold to what is real and let the rest go.
queries.act: Let go of the result you cannot control, and give your mind one hour of rest a day; when the 2am thought comes, let it pass and return to sleep.
queries.story: A man who stood on foreign soil with his family, facing a future he could not control, found that his own steadiness was what kept them safe.

bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call fear of what might happen, and that is where this week begins.
week_thesis: Seven days from the 2am check to one hour of rest, and from terror to the one thing you can actually hold.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the terror and the 2am check, named without judgement.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the fear is real but the 2am run is not. The mind is taking the reins of your peace.
week_beats.steady: You hold that what is real in you cannot be lost.
week_beats.act: You try giving your mind one hour of rest a day, and letting the 2am thought pass.
week_beats.story: A man who could not control the future found that his own steadiness was what kept his family safe.

insight: The visa is real and the fear is real. But the 2am check is the mind taking the reins of your peace and running with them.
details: has not had a weekend free of work thoughts
